originalTitle: ACC Q1 Results: Profit plunges 60% to Rs 147 crore on lower sales
simplifiedContent: ACC Ltd, a company owned by the Adani Group, had a significant decrease in profit (60.8%) to Rs 147 crore in the first quarter of the year. This happened because they sold less of their products, which led to a 7.75% decrease in the money they made. As a result, the company didn't earn as much as it did last year, partly because their costs were higher. The good news is that the company's higher-end products are doing well and gaining more market share. This news matters because it shows how the company is performing, which can affect its stock price and investor decisions.

originalTitle: REC Q1 Results: Net profit dips over 6% to Rs 4,193 crore
simplifiedContent: REC Ltd, a company, recently shared its financial results for the first quarter of the year. Unfortunately, the company made less money than it did during the same time last year, with its profit decreasing by over 6% to Rs 4,193 crore. This decrease happened because the company earned less interest on its investments. The company still decided to pay its shareholders a dividend, which is a portion of the company's profit, with an interim dividend of Rs 4.25 per share and a final dividend of Rs 1.55 per share. This news matters because it can affect the company's stock price and the amount of money shareholders receive.

originalTitle: Lodha Developers Q1 Results: Profit jumps 2-fold to Rs 1,373 crore
simplifiedContent: Lodha Developers, a company that builds homes and buildings, just released its quarterly results and they're very good. The company made a profit of Rs 1,373 crore, which is twice as much as it made in the same period last year. This is because the company sold more properties, with sales bookings going up by 4% to Rs 4,630 crore. This is the best quarter the company has ever had in terms of profit, and the company is feeling confident that it can keep growing its profits over the long term. This is good news for investors who own shares of the company, as it suggests that the company is doing well and may continue to do so.

originalTitle: SAIL Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 138% YoY to  ₹1,636 crore; revenue remains flat
simplifiedContent: SAIL, a company, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. Its net profit (the amount of money it made) increased by 138% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹1,636 crore. This is a big jump, even though the company didn't produce as much as it could have due to global issues. The company's revenue (the total amount of money it brought in) didn't change much, but it still made more profit. This increase in profit is a positive sign for the company's performance, and it hopes to have a more stable future ahead.

originalTitle: Pulse of the Street: Oil spike knocks markets to sharpest weekly fall since mid-May
simplifiedContent: Here's what happened in the stock market: the two main Indian stock market indexes, called Nifty 50 and Sensex, fell slightly on Friday. This meant they ended the week lower than they started, with Nifty 50 down 2.3% and Sensex down 2.6%. This was the biggest weekly drop for both indexes since mid-May. The reason for the drop was a spike in oil prices, which can affect the economy and scare investors. This matters because it can impact the value of investments and overall market confidence.

originalTitle: US stocks mixed as investors digest fresh earnings, Trump tariffs in focus
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the three main groups of stocks, called the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq, are moving in different directions. The Dow went up a little, by 0.15%, which means the value of the stocks in that group increased slightly. On the other hand, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq went down slightly, by 0.03% and 0.12% respectively. This mixed result shows that investors are carefully thinking about the latest company earnings reports and the impact of tariffs announced by President Trump. It matters because it can affect the overall direction of the stock market and the value of the stocks you might own.
